## Reversibility Assessment

### Reversibility Factors

| Factor | Assessment |
|--------|------------|
| Can this decision be undone within 30 days? | [YES/NO] |
| What is the cost of reversal? | [$ ESTIMATE] |
| What is the time cost of reversal? | [DURATION] |
| Are there irreversible commitments? | [LIST/NONE] |
| One-way or two-way door? | [CLASSIFICATION] |

### Reversibility Classification
**Type:** [TYPE I/II/III/IV]

**Definition:**
- **Type I:** Easily reversible, low cost (<$10K), short time (<1 week)
- **Type II:** Moderately reversible, medium cost ($10K-$100K), medium time (1-4 weeks)
- **Type III:** Difficult to reverse, high cost ($100K-$1M), long time (1-3 months)
- **Type IV:** Nearly impossible to reverse, very high cost (>$1M), very long time (>3 months)
